# ractermx_check_catalog (Data Source)

Reads the available security check catalog from RacterMX.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the available security check catalog.
data "ractermx_check_catalog" "all" {}

output "available_checks" {
  value = data.ractermx_check_catalog.all.checks
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `checks` (Attributes List) List of available security checks grouped by pillar. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--checks))

<a id="nestedatt--checks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `checks`

Read-Only:

- `check_id` (String) The unique identifier of the check.
- `default_severity` (String) The default severity level of the check.
- `description` (String) A description of what the check verifies.
- `name` (String) The name of the check.
- `pillar` (String) The security pillar (identity, shadow, reputation).
- `version` (String) The version of the check.
